concerns.location: tasks.md:T004 (geometric diagnostics) vs spec.md:FR-002/FR-003, constitution.md:Principle VI
concerns.text: T004 computes 'global linearity' as trustworthiness(high_dim, pca30) and 'local continuity' as trustworthiness(pca30, high_dim). FR-002/FR-003 and Constitution VI require Trustworthiness and the LCA metric computed on the high-dimensional space PRIOR to any dimensionality reduction, as predictor variables. Comparing to a PCA-30 embedding converts the diagnostics into embedding-quality metrics and redefines LCA as reversed trustworthiness — a semantic weakening of two FRs and a constitution violation.

T006 writes the literal string "Unavailable" into ari/nmi columns and omits the required silhouette_threshold column from its column list, while the fidelity contract types ari/nmi as numbers in [0,1], requires silhouette_threshold, and sets additionalProperties:false. The promised 'python -m jsonschema validation of CSV rows read as JSON' cannot pass as described; the deliverable falls short of the contract it claims to satisfy.

FR-007/SC-001 define the sensitivity sweep over Silhouette thresholds {0.4,0.5,0.6}; T008 computes variance_ari/variance_nmi/stability_passed over the Leiden-resolution sweep (0.1–1.0) and only 'also evaluates' the threshold variants. SC-001 as specified is never actually evaluated by any task deliverable — a dropped acceptance criterion.

Plan Phase 0.3 mandates updating spec.md to Case-Study mode and marking FR-001 'Partially Met' before any downstream task when raw counts are unavailable. The revision notes declare the prior plan-update task 'superseded' but no task performs the spec update; T003's 'exit 0 with ≥1 Available' silently relaxes FR-001's three-dataset requirement without the documented justification. Retroactive narrowing without spec-level staging.

FR-006 mandates the mixed-effects model fidelity ~ method + (1|dataset) with a likelihood-ratio test (SC-002). T007 substitutes fixed-effects ANOVA when <2 datasets, and the statistical_result contract hard-codes random_effects_variance as null, so a compliant mixed-effects result cannot be represented. The single-dataset fallback is documented in plan.md but the spec is never amended to permit it — the task weakens an FR the spec still states unconditionally.

Spec and plan require HVG count N 'determined by the variance-stabilizing selection method' (elbow-based, dynamic, no hard-coded number); T004 hard-codes 'top 2000 HVGs' with elbow-based dynamic N merely 'permitted'. Make the dynamic selection the primary rule or stage the 2000 cap explicitly in the spec.

US-1 scenario 3 requires 'three distinct 2D/3D coordinate sets'; T005 produces a 30-dimensional PCA embedding, so the acceptance scenario cannot pass as written. Either the spec scenario or the task dimensionality must be reconciled — currently the task silently fails a stated acceptance criterion.
